transactions.desc: The Rockies recalled Amador from Triple-A Albuquerque on Wednesday.
The Rockies reinstated Criswell (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday and optioned him to Triple-A Albuquerque.
The Blue Jays claimed Sewald off waivers from the Diamondbacks on Wednesday, Steve Gilbert of MLB.com reports.
The Boston Red Sox traded OF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles.
The Athletics recalled Rom from Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Athletics optioned Tur to Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Athletics recalled Juenger from Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Nationals designated Mikolas for assignment Wednesday.
The Nationals selected Kent's contract from Triple-A Rochester ahead of his scheduled start Wednesday versus the Cubs in Washington, D.C.
The Red Sox recalled Gamboa from Triple-A Worcester on Wednesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Red Sox designated Martinez for assignment Wednesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Dodgers optioned Barnes to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday.
Snell (elbow) was activated from the 60-day injured list ahead of his start Tuesday night against the Royals.
The Giants designated Leonard for assignment Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
San Francisco reinstated Bericoto (oblique) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
The Red Sox reinstated Rutschman (wrist) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday and added him to the active roster, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.
The Giants optioned Morgan to Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
Boston designated Rogers for assignment on Tuesday, per Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com.
Knizner signed a major-league contract with the Giants on Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Rangers selected Kelenic's contract from Triple-A Round Rock on Tuesday.
The Rangers designated Bride for assignment Tuesday.
The Pirates reinstated Yorke (shoulder) from the minor-league 7-day injured list Tuesday, Dominic Campbell of SI.com reports.
The Brewers signed Wilson to a one-year contract Tuesday.
The Brewers designated Richardson for assignment Tuesday.
The Yankees recalled Hanner from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Tuesday.
The Astros optioned Meyers to Triple-A Sugar Land on Tuesday, Julia Morales of Space City Home Network reports.
Colorado designated Julien for assignment on Tuesday, per Kyle Newman of The Denver Post.
The Rockies recalled Veen from Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
Philadelphia demoted Rangel to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Tigers released Gentry on Tuesday, Emily Waldon of Baseball America reports.
